name.title: Light Sensor Name
name.description: Display name for the blind_lux recommendation light sensor

indoorName.title: Indoor Module Name
indoorName.description: Display name for the indoor module accessory (temp, humidity, CO₂)

outdoorName.title: Outdoor Module Name
outdoorName.description: Display name for the outdoor module accessory (temp, humidity)

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to fetch weather data, in seconds

co2AbnormalSamples.title: CO₂ ABNORMAL sustain samples
co2AbnormalSamples.description: Number of consecutive polls above the abnormal threshold (or below the normal threshold) required before flipping the CarbonDioxideDetected characteristic.

co2AbnormalAt.title: CO₂ ABNORMAL threshold (ppm)
co2AbnormalAt.description: Above this ppm value, accumulate toward ABNORMAL. Default raised from the ASHRAE 1000 ppm guideline because the Netatmo Weather Station's raw CO₂ readings diverge from what the Netatmo iOS app displays (same instant, ~4×). Tune lower if your sensor is well-calibrated.

co2NormalAt.title: CO₂ NORMAL threshold (ppm)
co2NormalAt.description: Below this ppm value, accumulate toward NORMAL. Sits below co2AbnormalAt to give a hysteresis band where the previous state is held.

debugPort.title: Debug HTTP Port
debugPort.description: If set, exposes a 127.0.0.1-only HTTP endpoint for forcing lux values (POST /lux?value=N). Leave empty to disable.
